write_up: You moved from Accounts Payable Clerk to Staff Accountant at Rivermark Building Supply, and your resume points clearly toward staff accounting. It's common to describe accounting jobs as lists of duties, but that makes it hard to stand out when a recruiter is comparing people who all prepare entries and reconciliations.

Your journal entries and account reconciliations line is the best model: it names work a recruiter can recognize right away. Your dates and promotion are easy to follow, and Experience is in the right place above Education. The next step is to show what those duties involve at Rivermark.
